## Complete Work Order

Closes the work loop on a job: refuses to mark `completed` while a required checklist item is unresolved (unless the caller gives an override reason) and while no labour was logged (unless the caller gives `noLabourReason`) — "complete" always means the same thing everywhere, because this is the only place that writes it. `isComplete` is computed by the SAME `checklistStats` the Checklist Runner UI uses, so the UI and this gate can never disagree about what "done" means.

On success: stamps `completedAt`/status, and if this work order came from a Maintenance Plan, advances the plan's `lastCompletedAt` / `lastCompletedMeter` so the next occurrence calculation is correct.
